title: The Greyhawk Wars
content:
The cataclysmic wars of 582–584 CY that reshaped the Flanaess. Iuz the Old One invaded from the north, shattering the Shield Lands and Furyondy, while the Scarlet Brotherhood struck southern nations in a coordinated wave of assassinations and coups.

The conflict ended with the Pact of Greyhawk (584 CY), though Iuz refused to participate. The wars left tens of thousands dead, borders redrawn, and entire nations transformed or destroyed.
